 Will Richard 
 GSW 
 Guard 
 #3 
 Player Stats
 Link copied to clipboard! 
 Will Richards had himself a night with 20 points (9-of-13 FGs, 1-of-2 FTs), three assists, four steals, and a three in the loss to the Mavericks.
 Will was the only players on the Warriors that could get his offense consistently in this game. It’s honestly impressive considering he’s playing with his thumb wrapped up and he was hitting shots in this one. Getting the four steals is a nice bump, even getting one on his college teammate Walter Clayton. It’s a great performance, but it’s hard to project anything like this happening from him going forward.
 -  Brian Taylor

 LJ Cryer, Brandin Podziemski, Yaxel Lendeborg, Draymond Green and Al Horford will start against the Pelicans on Monday. 
 Cryer and Horford will be moving into the starting unit, with De’Anthony Melton and Will Richard heading to the bench. Cryer is getting his first start of the season after having 20 points, six assists and six three-pointers over his last three games while averaging 14.3 points and 3.7 triples per game during this stretch. He could be worth adding until Stephen Curry returns if he plays well in this one. 
 Brandin Podziemski 
 GSW 
 Guard 
 #2 
 The Warriors will start Brandin Podziemski, Will Richard, De’Anthony Melton, Yaxel Lendeborg, and Draymond Green against the Spurs on Friday. 
 Steph Curry suffered a right oblique abdominal tear and will be out for tonight’s game. The Warriors made two changes to the starting lineup, first with sliding Draymond Green to the five and replacing Al Horford with Will Richard, and then De’Anthony Melton will start in place of Steph Curry. Richard isn’t a great fantasy player, but Melton is the guy to add if he’s available in your fantasy league.

 ESPN’s Shams Charania reports that Steph Curry sustained an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks. 
 Curry sustained the injury in Wednesday’s loss to Houston, and it will keep him out until late November at minimum. In Curry’s absence, De’Anthony Melton should handle an expanded role after logging 25 minutes Wednesday after Curry’s early exit. Will Richard could also see some additional playing time until Curry returns.
